1.21.1.1.4.14: Fixed an End crash with Fabric Biome API / Connector (#17) and world-generation races alongside mods overwriting chunk generation like ByePregen (#16).
1.21.1.1.4.13: Fixed a server freeze while new chunks load when a mod reads a farther chunk then (Sable; issue #15).
1.21.1.1.4.12: The HUD where you want it: drag its boxes anywhere, a box of its own for any widget, any size from 25 % to 400 %.
1.21.1.1.4.11: New terrain faster while flying or running: still water and static blocks skip their post-processing (exact); 140 -> 206 chunks/s to a flying player (1.20.1).
1.21.1.1.4.10: Maximum speed: mods' mixin code inside vanilla mobs and blocks stays off the worker threads.
1.21.1.1.4.9: Safer Maximum speed / parallel ticks next to mods that change the same code: every guard of the parallel batches checked, the missing one named in the log.
1.21.1.1.4.8: Fix: world generation with C2ME no longer slower than C2ME alone (113 -> 149 chunks/s); Sleepium alone generates 307 chunks/s against C2ME's 168.
1.21.1.1.4.7: Fixes: with Lithium some chunks were not saved (1.21.1, since 1.3.5); Maximum speed / parallel ticks could hang with Lithium; a server stop with some mods' machines.
1.21.1.1.4.6: Maximum speed: chunk ticks in parallel (100 players: 30.3 -> 25.6 ms a tick); fixes: server stop with /debug or /perf, a mob at the loaded edge (both Maximum speed); quieter #11 refusals, passive glTrace.
1.21.1.1.4.5: Fix: flicker / stray textures / dark frames with mods drawing into the game's buffers (#11); Maximum speed: raiders in parallel (witch / raid farms 5.8 -> 1.7 ms); an opt-in switch for mods' mobs.
1.21.1.1.4.4: Maximum speed: villagers and iron golems on all threads (farm 29 -> 22 ms), creepers in parallel, items stay parallel.
1.21.1.1.4.3: Fix: parallel ticks / Maximum speed could stop a server during world generation; Maximum speed works with mods' tick listeners; crowds faster (pens 41 -> 25 ms).
1.21.1.1.4.2: Fix: the game stopped at start with Maximum speed on (1.4.1, clients only).
1.21.1.1.4.1: A cores budget per pool in the settings; Maximum speed on all cores (30k pigs 85 -> 50 ms on 8 cores, 20 TPS), parallel in mixed worlds, less overhead; view-edge chunks kept on 1.21.1.
1.21.1.1.4.0: Maximum speed (experimental, not exact): mobs ticked in parallel without vanilla's strict order - 30k pigs 315 -> 104 ms, farms 56 -> 30 ms; dropped items in the exact parallel ticks too; a parallel ticks crash fixed.
1.21.1.1.3.6: Parallel entity ticks (experimental, exact: 30k pigs 315 -> 192 ms), decoupled frames working with other mods, HUD size and new widgets, faster wall checks, farm slowdown fixed, world creation hang fixed.
1.21.1.1.3.5: Servers with many players (100 players: 9 -> 15 TPS), modded factories (-24 % a tick), much less disk load, world generation x1.38 with 16 threads, faster mobs and villagers - still exactly vanilla; experimental switches for busy servers; fix: no hung server after a failed stop.
1.21.1.1.3.4: Fixes: a crash with Bosses of Mass Destruction (#12; the crash screen's "disable this one" now switches off both sleep parts); Linux: no ~12 s freeze when the view area is rebuilt (GL errors from deleting buffer 0).
1.21.1.1.3.3: World generation up to 4.6x faster than vanilla (Chunky: 77 -> 359 chunks/s; 1.3.2: 228), exactly vanilla terrain; the Mods page shows where each mod's time goes; Intel UHD +5-12 % fps.
1.21.1.1.3.2: No quarter-second freezes on Intel integrated graphics (an N100's slowest frames: 257 -> 16 ms); fixes: the 1.3.1 machine cost check deciding too early, the render self-check now covers GeckoLib mobs and GPU-drawn items.
1.21.1.1.3.1: Fixes: worlds with many modded machines no longer run slower than without Sleepium (562 kinds of machines: 150 -> 16.4 ms a tick); a rare deadlock with C2ME + ModernFix + Chunky (#10); Entity Model Features heads and skulls; items in item frames; vanilla hoppers sleep fully again; quieter log (#8).
1.21.1.1.3.0: Much smoother flight at far view distances (32 chunks in flight: 162 -> 806-857 fps); Android above render distance 7; experimental Decoupled frames (off by default); fix: freezes in big packs from the mob analysis holding Mixin's lock; fix: repeated Mixin warnings (#8).
1.21.1.1.2.6: Fixes: CustomNPCs' script events were not registered (scripted NPCs did not react to clicks); a rare crash while drawing animated mobs.
1.21.1.1.2.5: No stutter when the camera turns at far view distances (32 chunks while turning: 167 -> 1 124 fps); GPU terrain: no cross of missing chunks from 31 chunks, no crash without OpenGL 4.5.
1.21.1.1.2.4: Fix: players were disconnected from a server with Krypton ('a frame cut inside a container', since 1.2.3).
1.21.1.1.2.3: See and choose what Sleepium does to each mod (Options -> Sleepium -> Mods), what each mod costs and where the server's time goes, a pack settings file for modpack makers, Find the cause, a HUD; fix: joining with Krypton.
1.21.1.1.2.2: Thermal dynamos and other mods' machines no longer stop under Sleepium's sleep (since 1.2.0); sounds no longer stall the game (a heavy sound mod's horde 11 -> 41 fps); measured choices kept per machine; no join stalls on Intel; the log names the mod Sleepium gave way to.
1.21.1.1.2.1: Android (MojoLauncher, OpenGL 3.3): no crash at start, a phone's entity scene 8 -> 42-58 fps, terrain 147 -> 222; F3 no longer halves the frame rate; choices measured on the running game; desktops as fast as 1.2.0, the same picture.
1.21.1.1.2.0: Intel graphics about 1.4x faster on terrain (direct chunk draws); particles up to 2x; machines' moving parts from the GPU; smoother frames; mods' idle machines sleep (report problems); a crash next to Bons and Furious fixed; experimental GPU terrain with LOD.
1.21.1.1.1.11: World generation with datapacks like JJThunder To The Max up to 2x faster (height-independent climate values computed once per column; same world).
1.21.1.1.1.10: Fixes world generation far from the centre being slower than vanilla (64 000 blocks out: 20-34 -> 123-126 chunks/s; vanilla 55), long teleports too; moving blocks' light a frame late.
1.21.1.1.1.9: Fixes 1.1.8 being slower next to ImmediatelyFast (dropped items 498 -> 1 765 fps); mods' entities added from a world-generation thread go where they belong; ObservedModSleep (off by default).
1.21.1.1.1.8: Dropped items drawn by the graphics card (about 2x fps with many items), cheaper collisions for orbs and items (exact), a documented sleepium.properties for servers, an ASM fix.
1.21.1.1.1.7: Fixes a crash when drawing entities with EntityBatch switched off; the same hooks fix as 1.20.1.
1.21.1.1.1.6: Fixes singleplayer worlds taking minutes to open next to ModernFix and mods that wait for server data while loading (ALI + JEI); "part of" switches in the settings take you to their parent.
1.21.1.1.1.5: Fixes joining online-mode servers (hung on Encrypting...), crashes next to mods that change the entity render call or reach into the event bus (Gnetum).
1.21.1.1.1.4: Fixes world creation crashing with very tall worldgen datapacks (JJThunder To The Max) and chunk saving failing next to C2ME.
1.21.1.1.1.3: Event hooks next to other mods: no conflicts and the speed-up back; entity sleep next to mods that inject into entities; the render cache learns fields that don't change the picture.
1.21.1.1.1.2: The settings screen works again (every switch was locked and shown OFF since 1.1.0).
1.21.1.1.1.1: Fixes a NeoForge server not starting next to mods that wrap NeoForge event posts (VerifyError in CommonHooks); EMF hook optional.
1.21.1.1.1.0: Works with Lithium, Radium, ModernFix, Iris, Embeddium and ImmediatelyFast without losing its gains; burning entities on the render workers; faster interpolated textures.
1.21.1.1.0.3: Works with Lithium, Moonrise, C2ME, ModernFix and Embeddium (they crashed with 1.0.2); water and glass in one draw (about 2x fps over water); water lit by light volumes.
1.21.1.1.0.2: A new settings screen with a live overview, presets and stats; shaderpack options screens; applying pack options without a break.
1.21.1.1.0.1: Shaderpacks prepared over frames (no freeze on a driver's first compile); the settings screen shows which flags switch which; the mod list's logo, links and update check.
